name: Touch-Close Mire-Thing

Actions.name: Multiattack
Actions.text: The mire-thing makes two Slam attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Miring Cone.

Actions.name: Slam
Actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +6, reach 5 ft. 17 (4d6 + 3) Bludgeoning damage.

Actions.name: Miring Cone
Actions.text: *Constitution Saving Throw:* DC 13, each creature in a 30-foot Cone. *Failure:* The target's Speed is halved and it can't take Reactions until the end of the mire-thing's next turn.

Bonus Actions.name: Umbral Step
Bonus Actions.text: While in Dim Light or Darkness, the mire-thing takes the Hide action.

Traits.name: Shallows Shroud
Traits.text: When a creature attempts to see or target the mire-thing from beyond 5 feet, or at the start of each of the mire-thing's turns while it is in water, a creature more than 5 feet from the mire-thing cannot see or target it, even when it stands in plain sight, until it comes within touch range; unless the mire-thing took Radiant damage since its last turn, it regains 9 (2d8) Hit Points at the start of each of its turns while standing in water.
Traits.clause: The mire-thing is unseen and untargetable until an observer is within 5 feet of it, even in plain sight; swamp-muck crus
Traits.expresses: invisibility that only breaks at touching distance
Traits.expressedQuote: a creature more than 5 feet from the mire-thing cannot see or target it, even when it stands in plain sight, until it comes within touch range

lore: A drowned hunter who would not stop stalking its quarry, the mire keeps its patience and its ambush but took its face and gave it a hunger that does not surface until far too late.

generation.userConcept: a mire-thing that is impossible to see until it is close enough to touch you

clauses.text: is impossible to see until it is close enough to touch you

generation.cite: composition after Phase Spider (CR 3) — the rider-heavy bite and the phase-cycle bonus action, scaled into the band
